item.title: ResuMatch
item.description: An AI driven resume-to-job matching system that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to deliver personalized job recommendations based on a candidate’s actual skills and experience.

item.title: Jobs ETL
item.description: A dashboard served by a pipeline orchestrated using Dagster to extract job postings from various job boards, deduplicate them, load into a PostgreSQL database, and transform via dbt and OpenAI each night. Additionally, a containerized FastAPI service behind NGINX provides secure RESTful endpoints exposing the pipeline outputs.
